earnings.title: AMAZON.COM ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER RESULTS
highlights: Operating income was $28.1 billion and operating margin was 13.9%—Amazon’s highest operating margin ever
AWS net sales increased 39.3%—its fastest growth in nearly five years—to a $184 billion annualized revenue run rate
Net sales increased 12% to $201.9 billion in the third quarter, compared with $180.2 billion in third quarter 2025.
Excluding the $0.9 billion unfavorable impact from year-over-year changes in foreign exchange rates throughout the quarter, net sales increased 13% compared with third quarter 2025.
North America segment sales increased 6% year-over-year to $112.9 billion.

quotes.text: Our AWS investment in functionality and infrastructure is working, with over 39% year-over-year revenue growth in Q3 ($184 billion revenue run rate) and projected revenue growth rates of over 40% both in 2027 and in 2028.
quotes.by: Andy Jassy, President and CEO, Amazon

outlook: Net sales are expected to be between $240.0 billion and $247.0 billion, or to grow between 12% and 16% compared with fourth quarter 2025.
Operating income is expected to be between $28.5 billion and $33.5 billion, compared with $25.0 billion in fourth quarter 2025.
We continue to expect 2026 cash capital expenditures to be approximately $220 billion.
